title: The fibre is an Ising partition function
body:
For any linear NAE triangle system with sharing graph G (V vertices, E edges): |A| / (2^r (3/4)^k) = Z(G) where Z(G) = < prod_{uv in E} (1 - x_u x_v / 3) > is the uniform average over x in {-1,+1}^V, equivalently Z = SUM over even edge-selections S of (-1/3)^{|S|}. Hence c = log2 Z(G). This is a high-temperature (van der Waerden) expansion at coupling -1/3.
the system is linear: no two triples share two coordinates

metadata.proof_text: Integrate out the private (unshared) coordinates triangle by triangle: a triangle with 3 private coordinates contributes a constant factor 3/4; one with 2 private coordinates contributes a constant independent of its shared coordinate (this is exactly why trees have c = 0); one with 1 private coordinate contributes (3/2)(1 - x_u x_v/3) on its shared pair; one with 0 private coordinates contributes (3/4)(1 - (uv+vw+uw)/3). Expanding the product over edges and averaging, every selection with a vertex of odd degree vanishes, leaving the even-selection sum. Machine-checked: 1,200 random linear systems across three seeds, exact rational arithmetic, 1,200 matches / 0 mismatches, covering all four triangle types, plus 12/12 structured attack shapes (K4, theta graphs, chorded cycles) and 13/13 additivity shapes (campaign 2026-08-20).
